title: Version 3.1.5 Changelog
items: Open any file type on desktop with its default app
Refuse to open programs, scripts and shortcuts on desktop
Keep both items when a paste meets a name clash
Refuse pastes whose items or destination folder are gone
Claim the Windows clipboard on in-app copy and cut
Paste whichever clipboard was copied last
Paste a copy any number of times and a cut once
Allow clipboard shortcuts only where the menu does
Refresh the open folder after a slow paste
Take the heartbeat session from the token only
Replace file icons with flat pages labelled by format
Draw every icon at one stroke weight
Remove dead code and check for it with knip in CI
Fail the Cloud Drive host build on dead code
Add git hooks for staged checks and commit messages
Limit the Docker build context to frontend and backend
Update backend, frontend and electron dependencies
Show each file's type label in Get Info
Keep dotfile names whole when extensions are hidden
Show shared files by extension on the share page
Add Explorer-style keyboard navigation to the file list
